minor.issue: Seed creates 25 empresas; spec asks for >=26 (note: ≥4 of expected brand names Tesla/Audi/Ford/Cemex/Pemex/Honda are present, so spirit of requirement met).

Response uses response_model=List[ProyectoRadar] which strips the `_source` field, so clients cannot distinguish AI-scraped items from API call. The brief requested verifying _source='ai_scraper' via /api/radar; currently only /api/scraper/status (counts radar_auto_scraped) exposes this. Either add `_source` to ProyectoRadar model or expose via a dedicated field/filter.

ui_bugs.issue: USA border line and 'FRONTERA EE.UU.' label call projectPoint(lat, lng) WITHOUT the (w, h) arguments at lines 123, 124, 126 of /app/frontend/src/pages/MapaPage.jsx, producing NaN for x1/y1/x2/y2/x/y SVG attributes. React logs multiple console errors (e.g. '<line> attribute x1: Expected length, "NaN"'). The border line and frontera text don't render visually but the rest of the map is fine.
Some city labels near east edge (Cancún → 'Ca…') clip outside the SVG/container at viewport width 1920; consider widening BBOX max lng to -86 or shifting Cancún label anchor.

issues: Banner ámbar + 4 stats cards + 3 action cards all render correctly, good visual hierarchy.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1790 lines and now contains scraper logic + scheduler + state inline. Strongly recommend splitting before V4: services/scraper.py (ai_scrape_compranet, run_scraper_once, run_scoring_batch, run_morning_alert), services/scheduler.py (_scheduler_loop), routers/scraper.py (status/run/score-batch/morning-alert), and config/state.py (SCRAPER_STATE, ESTADO_COORDS, SCRAPER_ESTADOS).

SCRAPER_STATE is a module-level mutable dict shared across requests; concurrent /scraper/run from multiple directors is guarded by the `running` flag but the read of `errors` list is unbounded and grows forever. Add ring-buffer (keep last 20) and add an asyncio.Lock for state mutations.
ai_scrape_compranet imports `random` inside the loop on line 1577 - move to module-level import for clarity.

_scheduler_loop computes CDMX hour as `(now.hour - 6) % 24` which ignores DST and Mexico's no-DST policy is technically correct for 2026, but better to use zoneinfo.ZoneInfo('America/Mexico_City') for safety.
scheduler sleeps 5 minutes; if backend hot-reloads at 02:01, the 02:00 trigger is missed for the day. Acceptable trade-off, but document it.

/api/scraper/status includes raw `errors` list and the internal `_last_scrape_day` / `_last_scoring_day` / `_last_alert_day` keys (added later by scheduler) which leak via `{**SCRAPER_STATE, ...}`. Consider whitelisting fields.

run_morning_alert sends ONE WhatsApp message via send_whatsapp regardless of TWILIO_ENABLED (mock path). Good for design, but the alert_doc stores `status=mocked` from send_whatsapp - confirm consistency with real Twilio response shape so frontend doesn't break later.
MapaPage.jsx: projectPoint signature has optional w/h but two call sites omit them → NaN. Either make w/h required (and pass W/H always) or default to 1 to avoid NaN.
ProyectoRadar Pydantic model strips `_source`; if you intend ai_scraper provenance to be queryable, either expose it or remove the design intent.

rca of the issue: MapaPage NaN console errors RCA: projectPoint(lat, lng, w, h) in /app/frontend/src/pages/MapaPage.jsx multiplies by `w` and `h` to produce SVG coordinates. Lines 123, 124, 126 call projectPoint with only 2 args, so w=undefined → x=NaN. Three SVG elements (USA-border <line>, FRONTERA EE.UU. <text>) silently fail to render. Fix: change lines 123-126 to `projectPoint(32.7, -117, W, H)` etc. Reproduction: open Mapa as director, check browser devtools console → 20+ React warnings.
